purpose: Produced art for the Help screen (src/ui/orrery/helpRig.js, helpInstruments.js): the steer ghost rims, hero renders for hulls the shared set lacks, and the six asteroid types for the ore mix.

rim.how: tools/art/help_hull_rims.cjs: each hull top render's alpha (assets/ui/renders/hulls/*.top.webp), median-cleaned, minus its 3px erosion, as an ice core over a soft bloom; lossless webp, 1024x1024, the render's own frame.

hulls.how: tools/art/render_hull.py (Blender 5.1 Cycles, hero view, 1600x900, 32 samples) on the game's own GLBs (src/render/partsLibrary.js WHOLE_SHIP map: mule/drifter/ranger _production_v1, hawser = yard_tug); resized to 1200x675. The atlas/bastion/ironback/warden/colossus/leviathan GLBs carry runtime-only textures and render blank in Blender, so Help keeps their class numeral.

rocks.how: tools/art/render_rock_type.py on the authored place_asteroid_rock_a/b/c and _seamed GLBs, dressed after the belt palette in src/render/visualFactory.js AST_TYPE (the gas cloud is a Cycles volume); 768 -> 640 webp.
